intro: Nauru is a single raised coral island only about 21 km² in area.

chapters.title: Land
text: A narrow coastal strip, where people live, surrounds a central plateau called Topside, mostly mined out into jagged coral pinnacles. Buada Lagoon is a small inland lake.

chapters.title: Water
text: Fresh water is scarce and mostly comes from desalination.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Nauru's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
